cases.claim: Declares httpcore as a Python dependency.
cases.rationale: The project.dependencies array declares httpcore==1.*. This establishes a declaration, not successful installation or runtime use.
requires-python establishes the declared minimum. Official support across Python versions requires broader evidence than this static declaration.
A top-level import pytest appears in a Python test file. This does not establish that the tests pass.
